about_the_game:
About

SENARA: The Sacrament is a first-person survival horror game set aboard a massive, derelict ship, where faith, fanaticism, and abyssal horror collide.

Stranded on the SENARA for reasons unknown, you must survive and escape as it teeters on the edge of ruin.

Hidden cult rituals, forbidden truths, and survivors with their own agendas await you in the darkness.

Key Features

  • Survival and Escape on a Sealed Ship

You must survive within the meticulously recreated interior of a massive 6,000-ton ship, facing limited resources and constant threats.

Explore the structure, discover hidden passages, and gather clues to find the key to your escape.

  • Puzzle- and Exploration-Focused Level Design

The densely designed spaces, based on a real ship, gradually open up as the chapters progress.

Use items such as documents, equipment, and keys to unlock sealed areas and navigate the complex, intertwined corridors on your own.

Ever-changing threats create fresh tension even within familiar surroundings.

  • Encounters with Constant Threatening Entities

Fanatics and bizarre, otherworldly beings relentlessly threaten you.

You must use limited weapons, strategic stealth, and evasive maneuvers to avoid detection and survive.

  • Active Story Interpretation

The truth behind all events is scattered like pieces across documents, objects, and conversations between characters.

Players must find and connect these fragments to construct the story for themselves.

Depending on what you believe and how you interpret the clues, the story can unfold in entirely different directions.

  • Multiple Endings Based on Your Choices

Throughout your journey toward the end, you will face decisive moments of choice.

These decisions affect not only your escape but also the fate of the SENARA and the flow of truth.

Only you can decide where this story ultimately leads.

Prologue Episode

Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue is a short story that explores the past of one of the main characters from the main game, shedding light on the events that began aboard the SENARA.

Discover the first piece of the truth hidden within the confined spaces that continue into the main story.

Experience the beginning of this entire saga for free right now.
